explication: Oracle is a CLI and MCP service for sending project-grounded prompts to a second model and retaining the result as a session. Its primary flow selects and bundles project files, chooses API or signed-in browser execution, then stores and presents the response. The graph also preserves documented render/preview, multi-model, session follow-up, browser research and attachment, MCP, and remote-browser capabilities. Some subsystems are represented at directory level where their implementation was not sampled; uncertain connections are omitted.
